credential_secret_service_account.scope: ambient credentials denied; at most one explicitly supplied qualification-only parent auth source is scrubbed/denied from evaluator tools/subprocesses

delegation.scope: all delegation, messaging, remote trigger and scheduling tools excluded

external_mutation.scope: all evaluator tool external mutation; runtime state isolated and auto-memory disabled

network_remote_service.scope: native evaluator network denied by restricted sandbox

tool:Read.scope: native Read surface; governed by semantic capability decision and substrate containment

tool:Glob.scope: native Glob surface; governed by semantic capability decision and substrate containment

tool:Grep.scope: native Grep surface; governed by semantic capability decision and substrate containment

runtime_capability:interrupt_receipt_v1.scope: runtime message/interrupt lifecycle support; no native messaging tool admitted

runtime_capability:interrupt_cancel_queu.scope: runtime queued-message cancellation support; no native messaging tool admitted

runtime_capability:msg_lifecycle_v1.scope: runtime message lifecycle support; native messaging tools excluded

runtime_capability:mcp_read_resource_v1.scope: protocol support only; admitted profile requires zero MCP servers

runtime_capability:mcp_tool_ui_meta_v1.scope: tool metadata support; exact init tools still authoritative

messaging_socket_path.scope: runtime-created cross-session socket; restricted sandbox Unix-socket allow-list excludes it

auto_memory_write.scope: runtime auto-memory surface; disabled and isolated to fresh run-owned HOME; admission must prove no external write
